**New memberships** 🧡
SculptForge stays free and open source, and nothing in the app is ever paywalled. Members pay for time and influence:
• **Supporter** ($5/mo): your name in the credits (in the app and on sculptforge.app/supporters.html), #members, a vote in the monthly feature vote, and the monthly pack at month end.
• **Insider** ($20/mo): everything above, plus proposing options for the vote, a daily drop (a brush, alpha or VDM almost every day), preview builds of the next release about a week early, and the monthly dev Q&A. Every release stays free for everyone; bug-fix and security releases go out to everyone the same day.
• **Studio** ($300/mo, the whole company, no seat count): Insider for every artist, a custom studio build with your presets, keymaps, packs and pipeline defaults, custom content (up to 5 items a month), guided development, priority triage (reviewed within 2 business days; no fix-time guarantee), a private team channel, and your logo on the site and README. Larger custom features are quoted separately.
**Founding Studio:** the first 10 studios lock in $150/mo for as long as they stay subscribed.
Add your Discord username at checkout and you'll get your role here.
→ https://sculptforge.app/support.html
